{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Queen of Cularin''''' was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]]-built [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]], that operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It often traveled through the [[Cularin comet cloud]], to allow passengers to view the floating space rubble that was located there. It was once attacked by members of the [[Fireclaw Horde]].
